# Lief Builders

> Owner's Rep, Project Advocacy and Oversight. Built. Different.

## URL
https://liefbuilders.com

## What We Are
Lief Builders is an owner's representation and project advocacy firm based in Scottsdale, Arizona. An owner's representative is a professional who advocates exclusively for the property owner during a construction project, protecting their financial and legal interests from start to finish. With over 100 years of combined expertise, Lief Builders puts experienced professionals on the owner's side so contractors and insurers cannot take advantage of what property owners do not know.

## Services

### Owner's Representation and Project Advocacy
Construction oversight and advocacy for property owners. Experience includes disaster recovery rebuilds (Greensburg, Kansas tornado and Santa Barbara fire damage) and luxury residential projects. Over 20 years as the owner's advocate. Every engagement is customized to the scope the project demands.

### Insurance and Legal Coordination
Full insurance claim navigation including coordination with adjusters, preparation of detailed draw requests, claim settlement negotiation, and partnership with legal counsel. Over $40M saved for clients through effective claim management and negotiation.

### Cost Control and Schedule Optimization
Faster builds, tighter budgets, and zero surprises. Full-scope project management including change order negotiation, site walks and inspections, vendor discount verification, value engineering, and red flag identification. 100%+ minimum ROI on every engagement.

## SABS Technology
SABS (Steel Automated Building Systems) is a proprietary construction technology offered through Lief Builders. It uses precision-engineered steel framing and automated manufacturing to deliver faster build times, lower costs, and higher structural quality compared to traditional construction methods.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is an owner's representative in construction?
A: An owner's representative is a professional who advocates exclusively for the property owner during a construction project. They oversee contractors, review budgets and change orders, coordinate insurance claims, and ensure the project stays on schedule and on budget.

Q: Why do I need an owner's rep?
A: Most property owners lack the technical expertise to evaluate contractor bids, negotiate change orders, or identify red flags during construction. An owner's rep brings decades of industry experience to protect you from cost overruns, schedule delays, and contractor disputes.

Q: What areas does Lief Builders serve?
A: Phoenix and Greater Arizona, Las Vegas and Nevada, and Los Angeles and Southern California.

Q: Does Lief Builders handle insurance claims?
A: Yes. Full insurance claim navigation including coordination with adjusters, detailed draw requests, claim settlement negotiation, and legal counsel partnership.

Q: What is SABS construction technology?
A: SABS (Steel Automated Building Systems) is a proprietary construction technology using precision-engineered steel framing and automated manufacturing for faster build times, lower costs, and higher structural quality.
